answers.core: Core: UX issue of Core Functionality
answers.workaround:
Can be worked around by typing any character (apart from space) into the `hint_tooltip` variable of any Control node. Although that requires opening the `Hint` dropdown, selecting the tooltip and writing at least one character in there. That's 3 actions more than should be necessary, if the tooltip doesn't use text/doesn't use that variable.

Can also be worked around by completely ignoring Godot's prebuilt `hint` functionality, and instead spawning nodes yourself. But that would be a shame.

title: Control's `_make_custom_tooltip()` shouldn't require `hint_tooltip` to have text
